summary:
"In Search of Curiosity" is a 3D survival-adventure game—developed with the help of an AI—set on the dangerous and mysterious planet Mars. Players take on the role of Apollo, a NASA astronaut tasked with locating and recovering the lost Curiosity rover.

To complete the mission, players must explore the Martian landscape, gather and extract resources, manage oxygen, water, health, and suit integrity, all while keeping a Martian base operational. Resources such as water, silicon, sulfur, magnesium, and carbon dioxide can be used to produce oxygen, fuel, energy systems, and filters, as well as to carry out repairs and craft essential survival gear. Additionally, players can utilize a vehicle and robots to traverse wider areas, discover new materials, and uncover clues.

Random environmental disasters can damage the base and introduce further challenges, requiring players to stay prepared and manage their resources with great care. The project explores the difficulties of surviving in an extreme environment while conducting a scientific mission.

The game stands out by blending exploration, strategy, resource management, and science, making the exploration of Mars an engaging and educational experience.
In the next phase of development, we plan to refine the graphics, gameplay, and overall mechanics—as the game was created with the aid of an AI, it is not yet perfect.
Finally, please note that this game is available exclusively for PC.
details:
In Search of Curiosity is a 3D adventure and survival game set on the planet Mars. The player controls Apollo, a NASA astronaut whose mission is to find and recover the lost Curiosity rover. Players explore a large 3D Martian environment, collect resources, mine minerals from ore deposits, and use a vehicle to travel across the planet.

The player must manage important survival systems such as oxygen, water, health, suit protection, energy, and fuel. Resources can be processed to create useful equipment, repair the base, produce oxygen and fuel, and improve the player's chances of survival. Robots can also help explore Mars, collect resources, and repair the base.

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with computer hardware such as a keyboard and mouse for interaction. The 3D environment makes exploration more immersive and allows players to experience the scale and danger of Mars.

The project is creative because it combines 3D exploration, survival, resource management, scientific discovery, vehicles, robots, and random Martian disasters into one experience. The team considered gameplay difficulty, exploration, realism, resource availability, player safety, and the importance of making the game engaging and educational.
